contract: RFC 6901 pointer-segment escaping. Three independent implementations must produce byte-identical output for every case below, because the Rust normalizer and the two sidecars build pointers separately and `source_map.get(pointer)` joins them by exact string match. A mismatch silently drops source attribution rather than erroring.
note: `a/b` and `a/b~c` are the order-sensitive cases: escaping `/` before `~` yields `a~01b` instead of `a~1b`. Keep them.
